notes.title: v1.2.0 Major Update - 2 New H-Scenes with 8 Gallery images has been added
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/xEVPAqw.jpg

To celebrate Summer Sale event, we have added 2 new beautiful h-scenes and 8 new gallery images to the game.
HOW TO UNLOCK: 
- You just need to finish the last chapter of the game (act 6 - chapter 9) and the new content will be unlocked.
Have fun guys! ːsteamhappyː
